name: Test Skill LLM
description: Test LLM driving skill adoption during a chat. Fresh: calls skill_load for the 'alpha' skill. After the load result: calls the skill-provided covia_read tool (proving same-transition palette activation). After that result: reports SKILL_TOOL_RESULT. On later turns with the [Skill: alpha] body present: reports SKILL_BODY_PRESENT plus tool-palette status.
